RE: Appeal of Adverse Benefit Determination
Member: Emerson Mercado
Member ID: W599128801
Reference Number: POC-2A69B0B828-71504
Date of Notice: 2026-07-31
Requested Service: Total hip replacement, CPT 27130
Requesting Surgeon: Okafor, MD, Orthopedic Surgery

To the Appeals Review Committee:

I am appealing the denial described in the Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination dated 2026-07-31, reference number POC-2A69B0B828-71504, which denied prior authorization for CPT 27130 (total hip arthroplasty) on the stated ground that "the documentation submitted was incomplete and does not allow a determination of medical necessity."

I am submitting this appeal within the 180-day deadline stated in the notice (by 2027-01-27).

**Note on the applicable medical policy.** The denial notice does not identify the specific medical policy or clinical review criteria used to reach this determination, nor does it name the managed care organization administering my Turquoise Care Medicaid benefit. I have located what appears to be the only publicly posted New Mexico Medicaid policy specific to hip surgery under CPT 27130 — UnitedHealthcare Community Plan Medical Policy, "Surgery of the Hip (for New Mexico Only)," Policy Number CS056NM.F, effective May 1, 2026. I do not know whether this is in fact the policy applied to my case. I am not attributing any other language to the plan beyond what is quoted below from that document, and I am not asserting that this document is definitely the one that governs my claim. **I am formally requesting that the plan identify, by name, number, and effective date, the specific medical policy and clinical review criteria actually applied to reference POC-2A69B0B828-71504, and provide me a copy of it, as I am entitled to under Medicaid appeal rules.** If a different policy was applied, I ask that the plan apply that policy's own documentation criteria to the records below and reconsider on that basis.

Below, I address the stated reason for denial — incomplete documentation — by mapping the documentation categories identified in the UnitedHealthcare "Surgery of the Hip (for New Mexico Only)" policy (which I am quoting directly) to the records already in my prior authorization packet, and by identifying what remains outstanding.

That policy states that the "Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews" should include, among other things:

"Condition requiring procedure[,] Severity of pain and details of Functional Disability(ies) interfering with activities of daily living (preparing meals, dressing, driving, walking) using a standard scale, such as Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Arthritis Index (WOMAC) or Hip Dysfunction and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score (HOOS)[,] Physician's treatment plan, including pre-op discussion[,] Pertinent physical examination of the relevant joint[,] Co-morbid medical conditions (cardiovascular diseases, hypertension, diabetes, cancer, pulmonary diseases, neurodegenerative diseases)[,] Prior therapies/treatments tried, failed, or contraindicated; include the dates and reason for discontinuation[.]"

It further states, regarding radiographic findings:

"Radiographic Findings of Osteoarthritis: Narrowing of joint space, osteophyte formation, subchondral sclerosis, subchondral cysts, deformity of bony end-plates, and thinning or complete loss of articular cartilage ... Note: UnitedHealthcare will accept three or more moderate to severe radiographic findings to be sufficient to support the diagnosis of severe osteoarthritis."

Mapped against my clinical record:

1. **Condition requiring procedure.** Weight-bearing AP pelvis radiograph dated 2026-07-05 shows joint space narrowed to 1 mm superolaterally with subchondral sclerosis and osteophytes — three distinct radiographic findings (joint space narrowing, sclerosis, and osteophyte formation), which by the language quoted above is the number of moderate-to-severe findings the plan states it "will accept ... to be sufficient to support the diagnosis of severe osteoarthritis."

2. **Severity of pain and functional disability.** I have experienced 14 months of progressive hip pain, unrelieved by rest. Functionally, I ambulate with a cane, am limited to walking one block, and cannot put on my shoes unassisted. I understand the quoted language references a "standard scale, such as WOMAC or HOOS." No formal WOMAC or HOOS score currently appears in my chart. I am requesting the opportunity to submit a WOMAC or HOOS assessment, and I ask my surgeon's office to complete one, so this element can be documented in the specific format referenced by the plan. [WOMAC/HOOS score to be supplied by Dr. Okafor's office].

3. **Physician's treatment plan, including pre-op discussion.** [Copy of Dr. Okafor's treatment plan and pre-operative discussion note to be supplied/attached].

4. **Pertinent physical examination of the relevant joint.** My exam recorded positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.

5. **Co-morbid medical conditions.** I have no active infection and no untreated substance use. My BMI is 29 and I am a non-smoker. [Full comorbidity list, if any additional conditions exist, to be confirmed by Dr. Okafor's office].

6. **Prior therapies/treatments tried, failed, or contraindicated, with dates.**
   - Supervised physical therapy focused on hip abductor strengthening and gait: 14 weeks, 2026-02-27 through 2026-06-05, 16 visits completed, documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
   - NSAIDs: 4 months, with inadequate relief.
   - Corticosteroid injection: administered 2026-03-30, providing only 2 weeks of partial relief.

I believe the enclosed records address every documentation category quoted above except the standard pain/function scale score, which I am arranging to have completed and submitted as a supplement to this appeal, and the treatment-plan/pre-op discussion note and any additional comorbidity documentation, which I am requesting from my surgeon's office.

I respectfully ask that the plan:
(a) identify the specific medical policy and criteria actually applied to my request, if different from the document quoted above;
(b) reconsider the denial in light of the clinical documentation summarized above; and
(c) advise me promptly, in writing, of any documentation item that remains missing so that I may supply it within the applicable appeal timeframe.

Please contact me at [phone] or [email] with any questions, or if additional records are needed to complete this appeal.

Sincerely,

Emerson Mercado
Member ID: W599128801

Enclosures:
- Physical therapy discharge note (2026-02-27 to 2026-06-05)
- Medication/injection records (NSAID trial; corticosteroid injection 2026-03-30)
- Weight-bearing AP pelvis radiograph report, 2026-07-05
- Physical examination note
- [WOMAC/HOOS functional assessment, if completed]
